title: How Do I Find Things Online?
style: calm luminous storybook watercolor with clear cutaway mechanisms

pages.text: The internet joins computers together. Pages can travel from far away to your screen.

quickWords.th: อินเทอร์เน็ต

pages.text: You type what you want to know. That is called a search.
A search engine keeps a giant list of pages. It shows you pages that match your words.

quickWords.th: เครื่องมือค้นหา

pages.text: If you want to learn about red beetles, try searching for 'red beetle' instead of just 'bug.'

quickWords.th: กำลังค้นหา

pages.text: Search for 'bug.' Then search for 'red beetle.' Which search found what you wanted? Why?
Search with a trusted grown-up. A result near the top is not always true or right for you.

quickWords.th: ผู้ใหญ่ที่ไว้ใจ
ผลการค้นหา

pages.text: A search result is not always true. Check who made the page, compare another page, and ask a trusted adult.

quickWords.th: ผลการค้นหา
เปรียบเทียบ

pages.text: You can search for anything you want to know. Try your favorite animal today.

quickWords.th: ที่ชอบที่สุด

pages.text: The internet can bring pages about anything you wonder about. What is one thing you would search for today?
